metadata.title: MedOrbits Career Options
metadata.description: Career pathways linked to educational courses, professional skills and further study options.
metadata.disclaimer: Career options are illustrative. Eligibility, professional registration, licensing and employment requirements depend on the jurisdiction, qualification and employer.

careerOptions.title: Healthcare
careerOptions.description: Explore clinical, allied-health, diagnostics, pharmaceutical and healthcare support pathways.

careerPaths.title: Medical practice
exampleRoles: Medical specialist after appropriate postgraduate training
careerPaths.licensingNote: Medical practice requires the applicable recognized qualification, registration and authorization in the relevant jurisdiction.

careerPaths.title: Dental care
exampleRoles: Dental specialist after appropriate further training
careerPaths.licensingNote: Dental practice and specialist roles are subject to applicable registration and professional requirements.

careerPaths.title: Nursing and patient care
exampleRoles: Nursing educator after appropriate additional qualifications
careerPaths.licensingNote: Registration, qualification recognition and permitted duties depend on the relevant nursing regulator and jurisdiction.

careerPaths.title: Pharmacy and pharmaceutical services
careerPaths.licensingNote: Registration may be required for pharmacy practice. Industry and support roles have different qualification and authorization requirements.

careerPaths.title: Allied health and diagnostics
exampleRoles: Allied-health professional in an eligible specialty
careerPaths.licensingNote: Requirements vary by profession, qualification, employer and jurisdiction.

careerOptions.note: Career examples are indicative and do not guarantee eligibility, employment or professional registration.

careerOptions.title: Technology and Engineering
careerOptions.description: Explore software, engineering, infrastructure, data and technology-related pathways.

careerPaths.title: Software development
careerPaths.licensingNote: Formal professional licensing is generally not required for ordinary software development, but employer and role-specific requirements may apply.

careerPaths.title: Data and analytics
furtherStudy: Relevant data science or analytics programmes
careerPaths.licensingNote: Requirements vary by employer and specialization.

careerPaths.title: Engineering and technical operations
careerPaths.licensingNote: Some engineering roles, regulated activities and jurisdictions may require specific qualifications, registration or authorization.

careerOptions.note: Role eligibility depends on the engineering discipline, technical skills, qualification and employer requirements.

careerOptions.title: Business and Management
careerOptions.description: Explore business operations, finance, marketing, human resources, management and leadership pathways.

careerPaths.title: Business operations
careerPaths.licensingNote: Requirements depend on the employer, sector and responsibilities.

careerPaths.title: Marketing and sales
careerPaths.licensingNote: Requirements depend on the role and employer.

careerPaths.title: Human resources and talent management
careerPaths.licensingNote: Employment requirements depend on the organization and jurisdiction.

careerOptions.note: Career progression depends on qualifications, experience, performance and employer requirements.
